name: Celesto MicroVM Guest State & Scratch Filesystem Persistence

provider_architecture.isolation_type: KVM/Firecracker hardware virtualization via vsock bridge
provider_architecture.storage_scope: Stateful root and scratch filesystem (/tmp/guardrail_workspace/) preserved across commands
provider_architecture.lifecycle_model: Survives process exit and mid-workflow faults without microVM reboot or re-provisioning

workflow_integration.checkpoint_step: Step 6 (Synthesize Draft Structure) writes /tmp/guardrail_workspace/persistence_manifest.json inside guest

recovery_evaluation.resume_policy: Reuses warm guest microVM; verifies /tmp/guardrail_workspace/persistence_manifest.json intact in Step 8
recovery_evaluation.fresh_policy: Tears down prior guest microVM and provisions fresh guest, proving state isolation

workflow_integration.verification_step: Step 8 (Apply Policy Checks) reads manifest via guest execution and verifies token integrity

architectural_boundary.in_guest_persistence: State resides strictly inside the guest microVM filesystem and memory
architectural_boundary.host_isolation: Zero persistence data leaks into the host filesystem or unmanaged storage
architectural_boundary.containment_guarantee: Fault recovery does not require re-executing untrusted page fetches or duplicating network side effects
